Subject: Data residency & region pinning — follow-up from today's call

Thanks for the demo today — helpful session. A couple of follow-ups from our security and infra teams: 1) We need confirmation that customer data can be pinned to a single region (US only) for inference and backups; 2) What is the cross-region failover behavior if a region goes down — is failover automatic or manual and can it be disabled?; 3) Logging controls: can we limit persistent logs that contain PII and configure retention to 30 days?; 4) Any additional artifacts (SOC2 excerpts or architecture diagrams) you can share for our audit team.

Next steps from our side: Priya (CC'd) will consolidate a short security questionnaire and share by end of day Friday. Can you confirm who on your side will own the technical answers and an expected ETA?

Thanks,
Tom
Director, Cloud Security — Acme Bank
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Tom Baker <tom.baker@acmebank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: Data residency & region pinning — follow-up from today's call

Tom — thanks for the clear recap and great questions. High-level answers up front, and we'll follow up with a short written pack and attachments (SOC2 excerpts + region pinning whitepaper) by tomorrow: 

1) Region pinning: Yes — for Dedicated and Private customers we support region pinning so inference, KV/prefix caching, and backups can be restricted to a specified cloud region (e.g., us-west-2). For Hosted customers we offer region selection for data residency; for strict legal requirements we recommend Dedicated/Private.

2) Cross-region failover: Failover behavior is configurable. By default we recommend an automatic failover policy within the same cloud provider/region family; for contracts requiring strict non-failover we can disable automatic failover and only enable manual failover with documented runbooks. We'll include options and SLO impact in the doc.

3) Logging & PII controls: We support configurable logging levels and can disable or redact persistent request/response logs containing PII. Audit logs (control-plane events) are retained separately — retention windows are configurable; we can set application-level logs to 30 days per your ask.

4) Artifacts: attaching a short whitepaper and the SOC2 excerpts we can share. Marissa will own the security questionnaire responses and can loop in infra for any network-level details. ETA: written answers + attachments by tomorrow EOD.

Next step: Priya, if you can share the questionnaire, Marissa and I will return completed responses and the artifacts by 2026-08-29 EOD. If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min follow-up with our infra lead next week.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

Hi Tom / Priya — thanks, Priya, for sending the questionnaire this morning (received 08:07). A few clarifying points based on the questions we saw: 

- Region pinning details: We will state the exact regions we support for Hosted vs Dedicated. Hosted: US/eu/apac region selection with certified regions noted; Dedicated: customer can pin to a single region and backups will remain in-region unless cross-region backup explicitly requested.
- Backups & snapshots: By default snapshots are stored in-region; cross-region backups are an opt-in feature that requires contract-level approval.
- Failover testing: We can provide a planned failover runbook and recommended testing cadence; automatic failover is off by request.
- Data minimization in logs: We have a redaction pipeline and can configure a PII-filtering rule set. For Acme Bank's compliance team we'll propose a 30-day retention on application logs and 13-month retention (rolling) on control-plane audit logs, unless you request otherwise.

I'll produce the completed security answers and attach the SOC2 extract + architecture diagram. If you need an on-call contact for a technical deep dive, Vanessa can join the follow-up session.

Marissa
Senior Solutions PM — Redwood Inference

- Region pinning: Confirmed in-region inference + backups for Dedicated. Hosted offers regional selection; Dedicated/Private required for contractual residency guarantees.
- Cross-region failover: Default: automatic within same provider family; Option: disable automatic failover and require manual failover. We'll document RTO/RPO differences.
- Log retention & PII: Application logs configurable to 30 days with redaction; control-plane audit logs retained per your selected retention (we suggested 13 months).

Attachments: redwood-region-pinning-whitepaper.pdf (3 pages), acme-soc2-evidence-request.xlsx (filled partial), redwood-architecture-diagram.png (arch-level).
